text:
alex: Quick heads-up — ran a cross-region benchmark (us-west2 / us-east1 / eu-west1) comparing PCIe vs SXM for the 7B quantized bring-up. Short tl;dr: SXM w/ NVLink: ~18% lower p99 latency, PCIe: ~12% higher throughput at batch sizes 8-16. Details below, dashboard: https://console.internal/bench/1729804321
sam: Nice. Did you pin CPU and GPU affinity (NUMA bind)?
alex: Yes. Used numactl --cpunodebind=0 --membind=0 and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. But on PCIe nodes we still see cross-socket traffic per `nvidia-smi topo -m`.
alex: ```
# nvidia-smi topo -m (pci-e node)
GPU0 GPU1 CPU Affinity
GPU0  X   SYS  0-15
GPU1  SYS  X   16-31
```
toni: Which kernels were selected? Did runtime fallback to cuBLAS? That makes a big diff for small sequences.
alex: Runtime picked optimized fused-attn on SXM, but on PCIe for seq_len>1024 it fell back to matmul + col2im path. We saw extra memcpy.
perf-bot: smoke-report: p50/p95/p99 for SXM(wnvlink): 12/32/85 ms, PCIe: 14/38/102 ms. throughput (tokens/s): SXM 120k, PCIe 134k @ batch=16.
mia: Any sign of quality regressions with int8 quant? We noticed ~1.5 BLEU drop in earlier runs.
alex: For this run, int8 had ~0.8 BLEU drop on PCIe vs SXM. Suspect reorder in KV-cache path + fused kernel mismatch. Collecting full trace.
sam: Can you rerun with explicit kernel override? In runtime config set kernel_preference=FUSED_ATTENTION, and try prefetch disabled. Also try pinning mps threads: export CUDA_MPS_ACTIVE_THREAD_PERCENTAGE=50
alex: Commands I'm going to run:
```
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1
numactl --cpunodebind=0 --membind=0 \
  ./run_infer --model 7B-quant --batch 16 --seq 2048 \
  --runtime-config kernel_preference=FUSED_ATTENTION,kvprefetch=false
```
alex: Kicking off three configs: (1) SXM default, (2) PCIe default, (3) PCIe pinned + kernel_override. Will post CSV and perf flame when done.
infra: FYI I'm marking dedicated GPU pools to repro under same HW; will add tags in the job.
alex: Thanks — aim to have results + short note by EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
